This page shows `mcp-console --help` and subcommand help for macOS, Linux, and Windows.
For usage examples, see the [command-line reference](CLI.md).
Run `mcp-console --help` to see the help for your installed version.

The `worker` command is an internal interface described in [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md).
